oracode.title: Oracode
oracode.subtitle: The paradigm
oracode.intro: A software development system with LLMs, designed for those who build to last.
oracode.pillar_1_desc: Every file declares its purpose. No code exists without a documented reason.
oracode.pillar_2_desc: No premature abstraction. Three similar lines beat a premature pattern.
oracode.pillar_3_desc: Unified terminology. One concept, one name, everywhere.
oracode.pillar_4_desc: Every bug becomes a test. Every feature becomes a pattern.
oracode.pillar_5_desc: Documentation updates automatically with the code.
oracode.pillar_6_desc: GDPR, audit trail, error handling — built in, not bolted on.
oracode.level_1_desc: One project with P0 rules, hooks, signature. Already meaningful.
oracode.level_2_desc: Mission protocol, DOC-SYNC, specialized agents. The project self-documents.
oracode.level_3_desc: Documentary nervous system. The software knows itself via RAG.
oracode.level_4_desc: An ecosystem of projects coordinated by a central brain. FlorenceEGI.
oracode.zero_rule_quote: If you don't know, ask. Never infer.
oracode.zero_rule_detail: The simplest rule and the most violated. An LLM that completes statistically invents what it doesn't know. Oracode blocks it first.

prove.title: The proof
prove.subtitle: Verifiable numbers, git log links, complete audits.
prove.proj_sigillo_what: Blockchain file certification — SHA-256 + Algorand + TSA RFC 3161
prove.proj_sigillo_integrations: Algorand, Stripe, IPFS, TSA, AI advisor
prove.proj_credential_what: W3C professional credential wallet — 11 standards (SD-JWT, OID4VCI, EdDSA, DID:web, eIDAS 2.0)
prove.proj_credential_compare: Same compliance level as Microsoft Entra Verified ID — a team of 50-100 engineers, 3+ years.
prove.proj_gialloro_what: Luxury e-commerce + headless CMS — Laravel + React + MariaDB
prove.proj_gialloro_integrations: Optimized SEO, WCAG AA, complete deploy
prove.proj_gialloro_compare: Two days to build. One day for SEO, accessibility, and deploy.
prove.methodology_p1: All hours are measured from verifiable git sessions: first commit — last commit per session, with a 15-minute pre/post tolerance.
prove.methodology_p2: Lines of code are counted with cloc on clean codebases (excluding node_modules, vendor, build artifacts).
prove.methodology_p3: Comparison data with traditional teams are conservative estimates based on public industry benchmarks for projects of equivalent complexity.

ecosistema.title: Ecosystem
ecosistema.subtitle: 9 platforms, one organism. FlorenceEGI.
ecosistema.organ_egi_desc: Creator economy, Algorand blockchain assets, shared core services (auth, payment, Egili). Host for Sigillo and future products.
ecosistema.organ_hub_desc: Single SSOT for configuration of all organs. No organ self-configures. Absolute hierarchical authority.
ecosistema.organ_hub_home_desc: World-class 3D entry point to the ecosystem. Integrates Sigillo as secondary entrypoint.
ecosistema.organ_natan_desc: RAG on Public Administration records + AI assistant for Italian municipalities. 56,000 documents, 190,000 vector chunks.
ecosistema.organ_credential_desc: Professional competencies certified on Algorand. 11 standards (SD-JWT, OID4VCI, EdDSA, DID:web, eIDAS 2.0).
ecosistema.organ_sigillo_desc: SHA-256 + Algorand + TSA RFC 3161 certification of any file. Third-party enforceable proof.
ecosistema.organ_bottega_desc: AI Maestro, 12 tools, 3 paths. Artist development as a brand + informed valuation for collectors.
ecosistema.organ_info_desc: Public informational page for FlorenceEGI. Zero backend.
ecosistema.organ_staging_desc: The creator chooses template, animation, 3D scene, subdomain. FlorenceEGI builds the site.
ecosistema.infra_p1: A single PostgreSQL database (AWS RDS) shared by all organs. Schema core.* with tables for users, wallets, Egili transactions, GDPR.
ecosistema.infra_p2: A documentary nervous system (149 SSOTs) indexed in a platform RAG queryable from every organ via AI sidebar.
ecosistema.infra_p3: An internal economic system (Egili) MiCA-safe that flows across the entire ecosystem.
